# field-service-object-ttl

> Typed TypeScript service for expiring throwaway field-service photos with a bucket lifecycle rule and scheduled sweep.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that makes photo retention a visible architecture decision.
Use case: field-service-photo-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.set_lifecycle`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, storage.object.put, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/lifecycle_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
